findings.finding: Values can be attributed to the wrong place while passing generation checks
findings.proposed_repair: Bind each displayed claim to one typed evidence tuple: entity, parameter, interval, value, unit and source. Render factual clauses deterministically; reject changed attribution.

findings.finding: Historical reads do not verify the serving database against its build manifest
findings.proposed_repair: Verify publication manifests and serving artefacts for both national and district data; source-PDF hash alone does not authenticate transformed values.

findings.finding: Multi-year and multi-parameter requests lose required operations
findings.proposed_repair: Introduce typed task lists, date ranges, requested measures and operation enums; track coverage of every requested task.

findings.finding: Specialist and daily-history adapters are unreachable from chat
findings.proposed_repair: Connect airport reports, marine, river and daily reanalysis through governed tools and explicit source entity types.

findings.finding: Four-variable forecast contract excludes available useful parameters
findings.proposed_repair: Add a separately identified extended forecast contract with units, nulls, model lineage, probability interval semantics and hourly timeline operations.

findings.finding: Warning ingest lacks complete applicable current alert lifecycle
findings.proposed_repair: Resolve feed authority, coverage, update/cancel chains, validity and geometry; keep historical/replay labels; then subscription/outbox/delivery lifecycle.

findings.finding: Documents are extracted pages without reviewed retrieval units
findings.proposed_repair: Build document-family structured extraction, issue/validity/place/crop/stage filters, parent context, hybrid retrieval and citation verification.

findings.finding: Place points do not support district/village area or specialist identity claims
findings.proposed_repair: Separate settlement/district/station/river/sea entities; dated administrative crosswalk, source footprints and resolvable choice/correction state.

findings.finding: Historical lookup is not climate trend analysis
findings.proposed_repair: Add range retrieval, comparisons, baselines, anomaly and descriptive trend tools with missingness and comparability checks.

findings.finding: Freshness scheduling is manual/request-driven and budget is narrow
findings.proposed_repair: Prioritized prefetch for subscribed/active footprint plus demand retrieval; unified budgets for all tools; source-aware freshness, retention and restore rehearsal.

findings.finding: Local global locks reject concurrent questions; no cancellation or stage streaming
findings.proposed_repair: Bounded queue, per-conversation ownership, provider timeouts, cancellation and progress; measure warm/cold p50/p95 before choosing hosted inference.

findings.finding: No user-level acceptance benchmark for all promised operations and languages
findings.proposed_repair: Version a scenario set with requested tasks and expected evidence; score completion separately from correct refusal/clarification, and test semantic swaps and stale updates.

findings.finding: Voice and mobile requirements remain incomplete
findings.proposed_repair: Desktop-first now per user; later speech transcript confirmation, TTS and mobile acceptance. Sarvam trial is optional and must preserve place/date/negation/units.

findings.finding: Private runtime data is tracked and reproduction/deployment packaging is incomplete
findings.proposed_repair: Separate curated fixtures from runtime conversations/logs; propose retention/deletion and repository hygiene, reproducible setup, CI and migrations before sharing. Do not erase evidence/history during this review.

findings.finding: Early design documents overstate compliance and suggest unjustified derived risk scores
findings.proposed_repair: Mark early hypotheses as superseded, keep PS wording authoritative, and require validated definitions before risk indices or operational claims.
